_comment: Loaded at start-up with --config <path> and never re-read while the server runs, which is
what lets BookingService treat it as immutable and skip locking on every lookup.
defaultSeatCapacity  - seats in a theater that does not set its own 'seatCapacity'.
20 by default, as specified by the project requirements.
defaultSeatsPerRow   - seats per lettered row, which is what decides seat naming.
Equal to the capacity here, so each theater is one row a1..a20.
Set it to 10 instead and 20 seats become a1..a10 plus b1..b10.
Every entry in 'showings' must reference an existing movie id and theater id; the loader
rejects the file at start-up otherwise, rather than failing later on a user request.
